API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIPolicy ResourcesGet Zpa Application Segments
Get Zpa Application Segments
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/zpaResources/applicationSegments

Retrieves the list of ZPA application segments that be configured in traffic forwarding rule criteria. To learn more, see Configuring Traffic Forwarding Rules.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
search
string

The search string used to match against the ZPA application segment name.

page
int32

Specifies the page offset.

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size. The default size is 50.

Default value: 50
sortBy
string

Specifies the application segment parameter by which the list must be sorted. By default, it is sorted by name.

Default value: name
sortOrder
string

Possible values: [asc, desc, ruleExecution]

The order in which the list must be sorted, such as ascending or descending order of the specified parameter or rule execution order.

Default value: asc
Responses
​
default

Default Response

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
deleted
boolean
description
string

Description of the ZPA application segment.

id
int32

ID of the ZPA application segment.

name
string

Name of the ZPA application segment.

zpaId
int64
]
